definitions.explanation: Having an iron face — utterly shameless and impervious to embarrassment or criticism. Describes someone who acts shamelessly without any sign of remorse or self-consciousness. Always negative in nuance.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}だ。

examples.english: Remaining calm even after being caught in a lie — there are limits to being shameless.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}め→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ず、{鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}し{通|とお}した→押し通す：20718_oshitoosu⟧。
examples.english: Without admitting his own mistake, he pushed through with a brazen attitude.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally means "iron face skin." Used as both a な-adjective ({鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧) and a noun ({鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}だ). The word is always critical — it describes someone who should feel shame but does not.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (brazen attitude)
- {鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (shameless person)
- {鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{程|ほど}→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there are limits to being shameless)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{厚|あつ}かましい→厚かましい：09161_atsukamashii⟧ (impudent) and {図|ず}々しい (brazen, pushy) are more colloquial alternatives. {鉄面皮|てつめんぴ} is more literary and emphatic.
